ns2:course.label: Honors Senior Thesis
ns2:course.description: (ANTH 293) Preparation and completion of a senior honors thesis, research paper, or equivalent project for those students who are candidates for high or highest departmental distinction in anthropology. 2 to 4 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. May not be taken concurrently with ANTH 390. Prerequisite: Senior standing; 3.2 grade-point average in anthropology; consent of instructor.
